mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book_reviews ( user_id, book_id, paper_id, emphasis_content, tone, delivery_date, delivery_time, ai_content, generation_status, is_sent, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{bookId}, #{paperId}, #{emphasisContent}, #{tone}, #{deliveryDate}, #{deliveryTime}, #{aiContent}, 'COMPLETED', 0, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM book_reviews WHERE is_sent = 0 AND generation_status = 'COMPLETED' AND CONCAT(delivery_date, ' ', delivery_time) <= NOW()
